subject: Mitochondria: the shared engine failure in aging, HIV, and long COVID
script: From Agewell Brief: Mitochondria: the shared engine failure in aging, HIV, and long COVID. A unified mitochondrial perspective reveals overlapping mechanisms—oxidative stress, impaired mitophagy, mtDNA damage—and points to organelle-level therapies. Mitochondrial dysfunction links aging, HIV, and long COVID. Oxidative stress and impaired mitophagy drive energy failure. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
